jobs.description: One original fantasy RPG inventory item icon: a vertical warm honey-brown wooden talisman plaque with clipped corners, a bold simple engraved TIGER FACE centered on its front, small round ears, dark stripes, two eyes and muzzle. A thick vivid golden YELLOW cord loop and knot on top, yellow tassel at the bottom. Use the input photo ONLY as inspiration for carved wood plaque construction; replace all artwork and writing with an original simple tiger face. Upright centered front view. 64x64 true pixel art, chunky readable shapes, 2px dark warm outline, 3-tone flat shading, top-left light, warm rustic handheld RPG style. Single isolated whole item occupying about 48x56 pixels with transparent padding. Transparent background. No writing, no letters, no kanji, no frame, no sparkles, no cast shadow, no hands, no red or white string. Must read clearly when displayed at 24 pixels.

verification.focusNotes: 기세·집중의 bbox는 동일. 불투명 실루엣 중 끝 끈 1픽셀의 alpha가 달라 mask IoU=0.999357. 모델이 모든 가시 픽셀 색 값을 바꿔 나무패 픽셀의 완전 일치를 보장하지 않는다. 육안으로 같은 호랑이 문양과 나무패 형태를 유지하며 파란 끈·윤곽이 구분됨.
